summary: Iter20 retest of iter19 fixes on UNIV-2026-BO-01 as admin. Everything requested passed, and no data was modified. Backend pytest: 10/10 PASS (5 new iter20 tests plus 5 iter19 regression tests). (1) PASS: with GET /actas?id_anfora delayed by 4s, the UI at T+0.5s and T+2s shows only the cabecera. There is no panel-formulario, no estado-acta-operativa or estado-bloqueado badge, and none of the Guardar, Subir, Consolidar or Enviar buttons are rendered. (2) PASS: after the response arrives, Ánfora 1 shows the 'Consolidada / Bloqueada' badge and the 'Acta consolidada' banner, Franja Rector (2d9c34bd) shows 50+35=85 válidos, 5 blancos and 0 nulos, and all inputs and buttons are disabled. These counts come from canonical acta 1a8614c1, which is tipo_mesa=estudiante. (3) PASS: /api/publico/procesos/{id}/resultados, /api/resumen/{id} and /api/procesos/{id}/resultado-universitario exactly match an independent recomputation that dedups by ánfora and prefers real counts, locked status, then newest. Ánfora 1 adds +85 válidos and +5 blancos to franja 2d9c34bd. (4) PASS: POST /guardar-acta with an existing id_anfora and no id_acta returns 409 'Ya existe un acta bloqueada para esta ánfora'. The set of acta ids for Ánfora 1 is unchanged (still 4). (5) PASS: clicking Cambiar ánfora, or changing the búsqueda directa, during the 4s delay stops the late response from bringing back the cabecera, form or badge. Apart from the single permitted duplicate-POST check, no other mutations were sent: Playwright aborted all non-login writes, and its log was empty.

minor.issue: The duplicate guard is check-then-insert (find_one, then insert_one) with no unique index on (id_eleccion, id_anfora). Two concurrent requests could still both pass the check and create duplicates. A unique (partial) index cannot be added until the legacy duplicates are cleaned up. As an alternative, use an atomic upsert with $setOnInsert.

issues: During the acta lookup, the area under the cabecera is blank, with no spinner or 'Cargando acta…' text. On slow networks users get no feedback. Consider adding a small loading indicator.

action_items: Optional: make the /guardar-acta new-acta path atomic. Use an upsert with $setOnInsert, or add a unique partial index on (id_eleccion, id_anfora) after cleaning up the 3 empty legacy duplicates of Ánfora 1.
Optional: show a loading indicator while cargandoActa is true.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py guardar_acta: the 409 guard is correct, but it is not atomic (TOCTOU race), and there is no unique index on actas(id_eleccion, id_anfora).
server.py resultados_publicos: 'escrutadas' counts distinct id_anfora on the raw list, which is consistent with the dedup. That is fine.

server.py _consolidado_publico and resultado-universitario: the projection omits esta_bloqueada and actualizado_en. Ties are therefore resolved by the sort order (newest first), and the conteos-first priority still works. That is acceptable.
CentroComputoPage.jsx: the cargandoActa and solicitudAnforaRef logic is correct. Stale responses are dropped before setCargandoActa(false), and limpiarSeleccionAnfora resets it.

Fill buscar-numero-anfora with '1' and click seleccionar-anfora-35cb374a-7974-4b5a-9cc1-e48977c1b535. Ánfora 1 still has 4 locked actas, and the canonical one is 1a8614c1. Run pytest with '-n 0' to see print output (pytest.ini enables xdist).
rca of the issue: The iter19 bugs are fixed. The transient draft is gone because cargandoActa now gates rendering and puedeEditar. The zero counts are gone because the frontend sort and the backend _actas_unicas_por_anfora both prefer actas with non-empty conteos.
